name: Symbolika
storyline: The universe is not unique. It is but a fraction of an Omniverse composed of billions of parallel realities, fractured timelines, and forgotten dimensions. At the center of it all resides Symbolikus, a cosmic entity as old as time itself. Symbolikus is not a god, he is a Collector. He seeks chaos, the unpredictable, the statistical anomaly capable of surprising him. To entertain himself, he created a pocket dimension, "The Prism Arena", where he teleports elite fighters plucked from across space and time. You are neither a hero nor a mere candidate: you are a variable. Symbolikus chose you because your destiny is blurred. He wants to see if you will be able to transcend classic archetypes (Warrior, Mage, Cyber...) by mastering the magic of Symbols. Your goal? Traverse the 29 Strata of the Arena, Use powerful combinations based on the values and symbols of your cards to deal devastating damage to your enemies, reach the Creator, and prove your worth by leaving an indelible mark on him.
